notes.title: UPDATE: STRIPPER ANYA CHRISTMAS SPECIAL! version 1.1!!
notes.content:
So! Version. Uno punto unz is lizzive!

Yerp, Version 1.1 - live. Right now. What's new?

[strike]Absolutely nothing![/strike]

[b]1. AUTO REVERSAL:[/b] There is now an option to activate the Sword auto reversal attack. Basically, if you press forward Z (keyboard) / forward X (Xbox) and perform Anya's sliding sword attack - you can press and hold the opposite direction during the attack to automatically perform the attack in the other direction - aka AUTO REVERSAL. Turns out - a large enough group of people thought that this added feature was glitchy, [b]SO NOW [/b]you have to [b]enable the ability to do the auto Reversal from the options screen[/b]. 

[b]2. CAN'T BACK OUT OF UNLOCK STRIPPER: [/b]Glitch Patch - Prior to the update, if you selected to unlock a Stripper in the Stripper's Lounge, before you could not back out of the option to unlock. [u]This has been patched[/u].

[i]Need a tutorial?[/i]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XsMiuSSkBV8&list=PLNlKSzA2BNI4w6CuRex4Oe-gDSLP5tKzK&index=11
Feel free to subscribe to the channel too!

That is about it - Thanks everyone and anyone that has supported X-MiGuPLAY! Got more games available and coming soon, just gonna link em below and ...

Please keep the feedback coming in! info@xmiguplay.com



Regards, 
-M
